# Tweak catalog

A tweak point is a named place where a mod can change a value, without knowing which game method computes it. `game.tweaks.on(name, fn)` installs the hook for you and passes `{ value, instance, args }` to your function, which returns the new value (or nil to keep the game's). The kit is Experimental in the [stability tiers](stability.md).

```lua
-- Colonists get hungry half as fast
game.tweaks.on("pawn.hunger_rate", function(t) return t.value * 0.5 end)

-- Better shooters hit more often (the Super Accuracy mod, in one line)
game.tweaks.on("shot.hit_factor_shooter", function(t) return math.min(1, t.value + 0.2) end)
```

A tweak is a hook underneath, so the same rules apply: it runs on whichever thread runs the method, and a tweak on a method the game calls thousands of times a tick costs time. `game.hooks.list()` shows what each one costs. For stats, `game.stats.modify` is usually the better tool, see [research and stats](research.md). To change a def's number once instead of every call, use [`game.defs.set`](defs.md).

The catalog is data: `src/api/tweaks.json`. Adding a tweak point is one row, and this page and the editor completions are generated from it. The game-update watch checks every row's target against the running game.

## Tweak points

| Name | Result | Target | What it changes |
|------|--------|--------|-----------------|
| `pawn.hunger_rate` | number | `RimWorld.Need_Food.get_FoodFallPerTick` | How fast a pawn's food need falls each tick. |
| `pawn.rest_fall_rate` | number | `RimWorld.Need_Rest.get_RestFallPerTick` | How fast a pawn's rest need falls each tick. |
| `pawn.joy_fall_rate` | number | `RimWorld.Need_Joy.get_FallPerInterval` | How fast a pawn's recreation need falls per need interval. |
| `pawn.carry_capacity` | number | `RimWorld.MassUtility.Capacity` | How much mass a pawn can carry. args[1] is the pawn. |
| `plant.growth_rate` | number | `RimWorld.Plant.get_GrowthRate` | How fast a plant grows. instance is the plant. |
| `thing.max_hit_points` | integer | `Verse.Thing.get_MaxHitPoints` | The most hit points a thing can have. Called very often. |
| `thing.market_value` | number | `Verse.Thing.get_MarketValue` | What a thing is worth, which feeds wealth, raids and trade. |
| `time.rate_multiplier` | number | `Verse.TickManager.get_TickRateMultiplier` | How fast the game runs for the current speed setting. |
| `shot.hit_factor_shooter` | number | `Verse.ShotReport.HitFactorFromShooter` | The part of a shot's hit chance that comes from the shooter's skill. args[1] is the shooter. |
| `health.bleed_rate` | number | `Verse.HediffSet.get_BleedRateTotal` | How fast a pawn bleeds in total. |
| `health.pain_total` | number | `Verse.HediffSet.get_PainTotal` | A pawn's total pain. |
| `social.opinion` | integer | `RimWorld.Pawn_RelationsTracker.OpinionOf` | What one pawn thinks of another, from -100 to 100. args[1] is the other pawn. |
| `power.plant_output` | number | `RimWorld.CompPowerPlant.get_DesiredPowerOutput` | The power a generator wants to produce. |
